ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within circle $\odot O$, diameter $AB \perp CD$, and $\angle A=26^\circ$, what is the degree measure of the inscribed angle subtended by chord $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram: Connect OC, BC, take a point E on arc AC, and connect AE, CE,\\
$\because OA=OC$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=180^\circ-2\times 26^\circ=128^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle B=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\times 128^\circ=64^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle E=180^\circ-\angle B=116^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ the measure of the inscribed angle facing chord AC is $\boxed{64^\circ}$ or $116^\circ$.

C is located at the lower right of the circle, AC is the chord from A to C, and BC can also be connected to form triangle ABC. D is on AB, CD is horizontally connected to C, and there is a right-angle mark at D, indicating that CD is perpendicular to AB. Reasoning: The problem gives ∠A = ∠BAC = 26°. Because AB is the diameter of the circle and C is on the circle, by Thales' theorem, ∠ACB = 90°. In triangle ABC, ∠ABC = 180° − 90° − 26° = 64°. ∠ABC is an inscribed angle with B as the vertex and with the subtended chord AC. For the same chord AC, the inscribed angle located on the other-side circular arc is supplementary to it, so another possible inscribed angle is 180° − 64° = 116°. Therefore, the measure of the inscribed angle subtended by chord AC is 64° or 116°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A is the top endpoint and B the bottom endpoint of the vertical diameter AB of circle O; C lies on the lower-right part of the circle; AC is the chord whose subtended inscribed angles are requested; D lies on AB with CD perpendicular to AB, confirming C is on the right/lower arc. From the text, take ∠A = ∠BAC = 26°. Since AB is a diameter and C is on the circle, apply Thales' theorem to triangle ABC to get ∠ACB = 90°. Then ∠ABC = 180° − 90° − 26° = 64°. This angle ∠ABC is an inscribed angle subtending chord AC. For a chord, inscribed angles with vertices on the opposite arc are supplementary, so the other possible inscribed angle subtending chord AC is 180° − 64° = 116°. Therefore the possible measures are 64° or 116°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是圆 O，A 在圆的最上端，B 在圆的最下端，AB 是竖直直径，O 在 AB 上。C 位于圆的右下方，AC 是从 A 到 C 的弦，BC 也可连接成三角形 ABC。D 在 AB 上，CD 水平连接到 C，且在 D 处有直角标记，表示 CD 垂直 AB。推理：题目给出 ∠A = ∠BAC = 26°。因为 AB 是圆的直径，C 在圆上，所以由泰勒斯定理，∠ACB = 90°。在三角形 ABC 中，∠ABC = 180° − 90° − 26° = 64°。∠ABC 是以 B 为顶点、所对弦为 AC 的圆周角。对于同一条弦 AC，位于另一侧圆弧上的圆周角与它互补，所以另一个可能的圆周角为 180° − 64° = 116°。因此，弦 AC 所对的圆周角度数为 64° 或 116°。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer gives exactly the same possible measures, 64° and 116°, as the standard answer.
